csv_scope_of_work: This project provides architectural/engineering/planning (AEP) resources to assist UW-Stevens Point in the investigation, research, and pre-design services necessary to facilitate campus planning and capital project development. The requested services under this project require a high level of experience and expertise. Desired services include... investigation and documentation of existing conditions investigation of related building code and technical issues and recommendations for action investigation of architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, telecommunication systems, life safety, site improvements, and site utilities. conducting feasibility studies and providing associated documentation cost estimation and documentation project scope development and documentation project schedule development and documentation construction phasing alternative development and documentation origin-destination planning and documentation
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Cost Estimating, Feasibility Studies, Site Evaluation/Selection, Electrical Engineering, Fire Protection Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

title: AEP for UW-Stevens Point
short_description: Campus planning and pre-design services for capital project development at UW-Stevens Point.
project_scope: Provision of architectural, engineering, and planning resources for investigation, research, and pre-design services to support campus planning and capital project development at UW-Stevens Point. Scope includes documentation of existing conditions; review of building code and technical issues; investigation of architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, telecommunications, life safety, site improvements, and site utilities; feasibility studies; cost estimating; project scope, schedule, and construction phasing development; and origin-destination planning.
services: Architectural and engineering planning services; pre-design; feasibility studies; rehabilitation/refurbishment input; civil engineering; cost estimating; site evaluation/selection; and multidisciplinary investigations across structural and building systems.
relevance_explanation:
- University campus project, which is generally of strategic interest.
- However, this is primarily an on-call/pre-design AEP support assignment rather than a defined structural project.
- Includes structural investigation, civil engineering, and rehabilitation/refurbishment aspects, offering some relevance.
- No specific bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or architecturally demanding special structure is identified.
- Broad campus planning and feasibility scope reduces direct fit with sbp's core structural design strengths.

fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided in the source. The notice describes AEP resources for investigations, feasibility studies, and pre-design services, but gives no consultant fee, percentage, or budget basis for estimating sbp's fee reliably.
references_qualifications: High level of experience and expertise required for architectural/engineering/planning resources supporting campus planning, investigations, feasibility studies, code and technical reviews, cost estimating, and multidisciplinary building/system assessments. No specific number or type of reference projects is stated in the source.
